title.narrative: Accelerating the way for an integrated approach to contribute to the SDGs & Green Recovery through ABS_ 01003100

description.narrative: Genetic resources are a treasure trove for humanity. Without them we would not have many of the medicines, vaccines, food, clothing, cosmetics, and other products that we take for granted every day. The international community, aware of the economic potential of genetic resources, brought forward the principle of Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) to guarantee fairness and equitable benefits to users and providers of these resources and to promote the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity.The role of genetic resources as drivers for sustainable development has been recognized globally. Nonetheless, ABS is still a work in progress and there are challenges that limit using genetic resources to support the 2030 agenda for sustainable development.Adopted in December 2022 during the fifteenth meeting of the Conference of the Parties (COP15), the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework positions ABS as a core element in implementing Target 13 and Goal C.A key emphasis of the first phase of the Global ABS Project was to create an enabling environment through ABS policy reform and awareness raising. The focus of the second phase will be to accelerate the sustainable use of genetic resources to advance the post-2020 biodiversity framework and the 2030 agenda for Sustainable Development.
